description:
Pirate Utility Pack

A ship pack of utility/combat pirate ships focused on exploring scraping/mining and resource transport.
Includes the ships and wings shown below which are added to the pirate BP and feature several logistical features as well as a custom naming feature for all pirate ships.

Mod technical notes

Spoiler
All PUP ships are combat specialists that have a utility aspect associated to them.

Each ship has better armor than standard but suffer from weaker hulls and inefficient shields.

Most ships have associated mining strengths that interact with Nexerelin's mining feature and are equipped with mining/custom drones. All ships are deployable and have a mix of utility and combat.

Many have salvage gantries, two have high resolution sensors, one has surveying equipment, one has a ground support package, two have an operation center, one has a Nav Relay, one has a custom ramming system and one has drive field stabilizers.

All ships and wing are available for purchase in pirate markets and have been added to the pirate blueprint.

The included naming feature is a list fo 70 custom tongue in cheeck pirate themed names. If this feature is not for you, you can go to the mod folder then navigate to data\strings and there is a file called ship_names.json, open it with an simple editor (notepad++ is a good free one) and delete the ones you dislike.

I feel that each ship and wing added fills a role that is currently missing in the pirate lineup and I may be adding more as ideas and suggestions arise.

ANOTHER Dazs mod?! you ask. Well here is my reasoning:

Spoiler
Over the years I have been asked by a couple players to add pirate ships to one of my other mods, JYD, which focuses on salvage and mining. At the time I eventually decided to not do that and the ships I toyed around with just sat on my drive. Recently I read a player complaining that that pirates lack any utility ships of their own and rely on independent hulls and that did not make sense to them since they clearly have combat ships designed by them. Top that off with a post by catfish on the Spiral Arms II thread of ships they designed for personal use and were free to use. Well my mods all about filling in holes in the game that I feel need filling and this inspired me to make these ships. So I dug out my old designs, used some of catfish's sprites and kit bashed the above ships. I do hope you like them.

Sources & Thank Yous

Spoiler
Each PUP ship is a Dazs kit bash using a mix of vanilla art assets and fee to use content posted on Spiral Arms II

Note: catfish, who posted a fair amount of the art I used on Spiral Arms II posted: No need to give credit. Well I feel the need and thank you for sharing them with the community.

Beta Testers: blueharizon, Kherae, happycrow, Quantum86, lchronosl, Selfcontrol, BlackOrb, Craboblab, TheCrispyDud and Sourdough - Thank you all for your input and appreciation!

A special thank you to Alex and team for their hard work making this game and keeping it up to date all these years.

If you enjoy my content, please consider buying me a coffee to keep me going! :) on Ko-Fi!

Current Changelog
v0.6 Save Compatible
-Rockchopper: Lowered the frequency it will be used in pirate fleets - Ty Blackpinned for noting it and sorry for the spam :)
-Howl: Replaced Advanced Ground Support with Ground Support - Belt made a good point that Advanced should be reserved for specialized ships
-Howl: Raised the deployment cost from 5 to 7 -  In retrospect I felt it was a little low for a destroyer equipped with a large mount
-Added a new ship, the Periagua: A capital ship dedicated to troop transport - A militarized double sized Starliner designed to absorb damage while deploying troops
-Added the new ship to the "All ships image" found on the forum front page and discord link - Take a peek and let me know what you think :)

Previous Changelog
Spoiler

-Rockchopper: Raised the deployment and supply use from 28 to 30 - TY Levidos for noting it needed an adjustment

-Scallywag: Increased the flux dissipation from 280 to 300 - To help alleviate the overload it can suffer

-Corrupt: Removed all built-in wings and re-armed the standard variant
-Rockchopper: Removed all built-in wings, increased the OP to 240 and re-armed the standard variant
-Note: The changes to the above three ships was due to reading multiple negative comments regarding built-in wings and I am all about player choice

v4.8 Save Compatible
-Adjusted the description for the Dutch - TY TheCrispyDud for the suggestion
-Dillon: Raised the supply use from 10 to 20 - Fixing an oopsie on my part that made it way too OP to deploy - TY KalHirol for noting it

v4.7 Save Compatible

-Reclassified the Muletender(P) as small carrier (was medium) and the Dillon as medium carrier (was large) - When I added the Dutch I noticed that I had misclassified, oopsie :(
-Added both new ship sprites to the "all ships" image on the forum and discord post - TY blueharizon & TheCrispyDud for helping me dial it in

v4.6 Save Compatible
-Added a new ship, the Alpha Wolf: A well armored command heavy destroyer for wolf pack tactics - think more tank than dps
-Added a new ship, the Grueling: A requested missile focused heavy destroyer with a custom ramming drive ship system - my TY to TheCrispyDud for all their help
-Added a new ship, the Dillon: A combat carrier light cruiser with a flexible loadout allowing the player to focus on weapon damage or wing damage
-Added the new ships to the "all ships" image found on the forum page and discord post - they are along the bottom right if interested

v0.4.5 Save Compatible
-Re-classified the Rockchooper from Combat Large to Combat Freighter Large - Better fits its role for fleet formation
-Increased the frequency pirate fleets will use PUP ships when forming their fleets - Upon review of other pirate mods, PUP was far lower
-Prometheus MK.III(P): Touched up the ship sprite - erased some stray edging, reddened the greenish/white middle and balanced the top edge - minor but less Lud and more pirate

v0.4.4 Save Compatible
-Renamed the Gangway to the Rockchopper - Name was already in use by another mod - TY spookedmoose for letting me know and TheCrispyDud for helping me bounce around names

v0.4.3 Save Compatible
-Added a new capital long haul miner, the Gangway: If the Prometheus and the Buffalo(P) had a child and militarized - TY TheCrispyDud for helping me dial it in and lchronosl for your moral support :)
-Phase Venture(P): Raised the speed from 60 to 70 and acceleration from 35 to 40 - TY TheCrispyDud for noting it was a touch too slow to engage
-Added the new ship to the "all ships" image on the forum and discord post

v0.4.2 Save Compatible
-Mule Tender(P): Added to the pirate BP - just fixing a previous oopsie
-Added a new cruiser, the Phase Venture(P): Faster, a little more fragile, phase and ballistic focused - TY lchronosl and TheCrispyDud for your input
-Added the new ship to the "all ships" image found on the forum page and discord post - It is top right if interested

v0.4.1 Save Compatible - Note: the new names only effect newly formed ships
-Added a new drone wing, the Dory: A pirate hacked talon but unmanned, armed with 4 mining lasers, 3 OP and 8 refit - TY blueharizon for the inspiration
-Replaced built-in mining drone wings with the new Dory on the following: Corrupt, Deceit, Discourteous, Madness, Pillage, Scallywag, Scorn and Muletender(p)
-Madness: Swapped out two of the previous built-in mining drone wings with Doubloon wings - Made that ship before I added the wings
-Added 70 new fun ship names for the pirates to name their ships - Akin to "The Black Pearl"
-Added the new drone to the "all ships" image found on the forum page and discord post - It is next to the Doubloon if interested

v0.4.0 Save Compatible
-Slightly increased the frequency pirate fleets will use PUP ships when forming their fleets
-Added a new Phase Capital, the Prometheus MK.III(P) - A fragile design that has high running costs but can pack a punch in a pinch and is equipped with Surveying Equipment
-Added a new Phase Destroyer, the Phase Buffalo(P) - Built as a durable combat freighter but sacrifices cargo space for an insulated engine assembly
-Added both new ships to the "all ships" image on the forum and discord post - TY Quantum86 for the suggestion for their addition

v0.3.0 Save Compatible
-Added a new ship, the Shepherd(P): Swapped out surveying equipment for shielded cargo holds, removed civ grade, brought it to PUP standards with less hull, more armor,
less efficient shield, lowered crew requirements, less fuel tank/more cargo space, equipped with the same mounts as the base version and replaced the Borer drone wing with the Doubloon
-Added a new ship, Mule Tender(P): Variant of the Mule(P) altering it into a drone tender by changing the combat profile from combat to carrier, removing the medium turret,
adding 2 Doubloon, 1 mining drone, salvage gantry and changed the forward hardpoints to missile only - Essentially the Shepherd and Mule had a child :)
-Doubloon: Added a third mining laser to help when it engages fighters - Since it replaces six lasers from the borer wing it balances
-Added both new ships to the "all ships" image on the forum and discord post

v0.2.2 Save Compatible
-Doubloon: Color shifted the red from a dark cherry to a lighter cherry and desaturated the palette a tad - TY blueharizon for noting it was a bit too garish
-Discourteous: Scrapped the old bloated sprite and replaced it with a more size appropriate one - TY Kherae for noting it and banano of doom for calling me out on it
-Updated the "all ships image" found on the forum page and discord post

v0.2.1 Save Compatible
-Replaced the ship sprite for the Corrupt - While I was playing I came across a similar ship that vicegrip made using the same graphic and I did not want to infringe
-Also blueharizon's comment that the previous version looked "like the chunky colossus" has lived rent free in my head so I chopped it down :)
-Replaced the Corrupt on the "all ships" image on the forum and discord post - Hope you like it!

v0.2.0 Save Compatible
-Added a new command frigate, the Plunderer - Low on guns but speedy and equipped with high resolution sensors and a command center
-Added a new drone wing, the Doubloon - A heavy version of the borer with 2 mining lasers and a hammer torpedo - TY blueharizon for the post
-Replaced the built-in borer drones on the Corrupt, Deceit, Pillage, Scallywag, and Scorn with the new Doubloon drone
-Note: I tested the above change and it does make those ships more powerful but not overly so
-Added the new ship and drone to the "all ships" image on the forum and discord post

v0.1.0
- Initial release for review, testing and constructive criticism.

   -Rockchopper: Lowered the frequency it will be used in pirate fleets - Ty Blackpinned for noting it and sorry for the spam :)
   -Howl: Replaced Advanced Ground Support with Ground Support - Belt made a good point that Advanced should be reserved for specialized ships
   -Howl: Raised the deployment cost from 5 to 7 -  In retrospect I felt it was a little low for a destroyer equipped with a large mount
   -Added a new ship, the Periagua: A capital ship dedicated to troop transport - A militarized double sized Starliner designed to absorb damage while deploying troops
   -Added the new ship to the "All ships image" found on the forum front page and discord link - Take a peek and let me know what you think :)
